claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026, at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day crewed mission to orbit the Moon.
The Artemis II mission will lift off from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II mission launch window is two hours long.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission around the Moon since 1972.
The Artemis II mission tests the SLS rocket and Orion capsule.
Additional launch windows for the Artemis II mission are available through April 6, 2026.
